provenance.author: VNText audit R12, 2026-11-11
provenance.source: Synthetic sentences authored for this repository; no game/user dialogue
provenance.selection: Contexts, common idioms, approved glossary and protected spans; finite regression corpus, not representative whole-game sampling

criteria.basic_vietnamese: All app outputs must be readable Vietnamese, allowing imperfect idiom/context; no corrupted Vietnamese words introduced by repair.
criteria.protected: Every explicit protected token and newline must survive with count/order.
criteria.terms: Explicit user glossary must remain exact.
criteria.semantic: Reviewer marks draft usability and idiom/context limitations separately; imperfect semantics do not silently become linguistic PASS.
criteria.review: Randomized opaque arms; reviewer sees source/context and output only; map revealed after saved decisions. Single model-assisted reviewer, not an independent human panel.
